content.comment_body: Hello everyone, I would like to know if it's possible to change the times of 10 timers directly from the integrated [product_name] display. I'm planning a project using a [product_name] controller with display and want the customer to be able to adjust timer settings through the built-in display, or if I should consider an additional panel instead. Thank you

One method is to modify the timer block value (for example, b003 for delay on). Press ESC to exit run mode, then go to program > edit > select the block (such as b003) > OK. Use the up/down buttons to adjust the value, then confirm with OK and ESC, or select another block to modify. This process isn't very user-friendly. Alternatively, using an operator panel and program with message texts allows for timer modifications via function keys, making it much easier and safer for your customer to adjust settings. I've included a simple circuit as an example to demonstrate how this setup works. You can also search the forum for similar solutions.
Just for your information: If you want to open the zip file from [user_name], you need to rename it to a .rar file. Best regards [user_name]

analysis.insight_summary: A user is exploring how to allow customers to change multiple timer settings through the built-in display of a [product_name] controller. Responses explain it's technically possible but not very intuitive. For ease of use and safety, it's recommended to consider an operator panel, suggesting the integrated display may not provide optimal user experience for this function.
analysis.user_expectations: The user would like customers to easily adjust timer values via the built-in [product_name] display, aiming to avoid extra hardware and keep the process straightforward.
